column1: # Golden matching corpus. Each row asserts whether two name forms SHOULD
# resolve to the same person by phonetic matching alone.
# should_match=yes  -> a real full-form/short-form or spelling pair
# should_match=no   -> a near-miss that must NOT collide (precision guard)
# mode=default -> evaluated with the safe default settings
# mode=bare    -> evaluated with include_bare_elements=True, which is opt-in
#                 because it collides names sharing an element. Rows in this
#                 mode document what enabling it buys and what it costs.
# status=unreviewed rows are asserted from common naming patterns and need
# native-speaker confirmation. A passing test on an unreviewed row proves
# only that the code is self-consistent; it is not linguistic validation.
